<a id="AudioEffectNoiseGate"></a>

# AudioEffectNoiseGate

**Inherits:** [AudioEffect](AudioEffect.md) **\<** [Resource](Resource.md) **\<** [RefCounted](RefCounted.md) **\<** [Object](Object.md)

Adds a noise gate filter to the audio bus.

<!-- classref-introduction-group -->

## Description

Attenuates or silences sound above [threshold_db](AudioEffectNoiseGate.md#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_threshold_db).

<!-- classref-introduction-group -->

## Tutorials

- [Audio buses](../tutorials/audio/audio_buses.md)

## Property Descriptions

<a id="AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_attack_ms"></a>

<!-- classref-property -->

[float](float.md) **attack_ms** = `10.0` [🔗](#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_attack_ms)

<!-- classref-property-setget -->

- `void` **set_attack_ms**\ (\ value\: [float](float.md)\ )
- [float](float.md) **get_attack_ms**\ (\ )

How long, in milliseconds, the gate takes to approach fully open, once the incoming sound gets loud enough to pass the [threshold_db](AudioEffectNoiseGate.md#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_threshold_db). Short values let the start of a sound through almost instantly. Longer values soften or clip the beginning of each sound.

<hr class="classref-item-separator"/>

<a id="AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_attenuation_db"></a>

<!-- classref-property -->

[float](float.md) **attenuation_db** = `-60.0` [🔗](#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_attenuation_db)

<!-- classref-property-setget -->

- `void` **set_attenuation_db**\ (\ value\: [float](float.md)\ )
- [float](float.md) **get_attenuation_db**\ (\ )

How much to attenuate (lower the volume) any audio lower than [threshold_db](AudioEffectNoiseGate.md#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_threshold_db). -80 silences completely.

<hr class="classref-item-separator"/>

<a id="AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_invert"></a>

<!-- classref-property -->

[bool](bool.md) **invert** = `false` [🔗](#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_invert)

<!-- classref-property-setget -->

- `void` **set_invert**\ (\ value\: [bool](bool.md)\ )
- [bool](bool.md) **is_invert**\ (\ )

Flips the behavior. Attenuates audio **higher** than [threshold_db](AudioEffectNoiseGate.md#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_threshold_db).

<hr class="classref-item-separator"/>

<a id="AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_release_ms"></a>

<!-- classref-property -->

[float](float.md) **release_ms** = `200.0` [🔗](#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_release_ms)

<!-- classref-property-setget -->

- `void` **set_release_ms**\ (\ value\: [float](float.md)\ )
- [float](float.md) **get_release_ms**\ (\ )

How long, in milliseconds, the gate takes to fully close once the incoming sound drops back below the [threshold_db](AudioEffectNoiseGate.md#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_threshold_db). Short values shut the gate quickly. Longer values let the tail of a sound fade out naturally instead of cutting off abruptly.

<hr class="classref-item-separator"/>

<a id="AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_threshold_db"></a>

<!-- classref-property -->

[float](float.md) **threshold_db** = `-40.0` [🔗](#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_threshold_db)

<!-- classref-property-setget -->

- `void` **set_threshold_db**\ (\ value\: [float](float.md)\ )
- [float](float.md) **get_threshold_db**\ (\ )

The volume level, in decibels, that separates wanted sound from unwanted noise. Audio louder than this level opens the gate and passes through, while quieter audio is reduced by the [attenuation_db](AudioEffectNoiseGate.md#AudioEffectNoiseGate_property_attenuation_db). Values closer to 0 require louder sound to open the gate, and more negative values let quieter sounds through.
